Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a production background painting for the native Godot cozy pixel-art game Window Diary.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing sunny window scene. Keep its exact camera, aspect ratio, window frame, sill, mug/books, pots, railing, bird food dish, entire left foreground tree trunk with hollow and nest, and all its important bare branches in exactly the same positions. Preserve the near right building facade and its windows. No animals, birds, insects or boat baked in.
CHANGE THE DISTANT LANDSCAPE: widen the river into a generous open river basin / small lake, with substantially more visible water across the central lower outdoor view. Replace much of the near shore grass at center-left with water. The far bank runs broadly across the scene about halfway down the outdoor view, and a legible long strip of small asymmetric waterfront town houses, tiny roofs, piers and low trees sits along that far shore, in front of the distant snow mountains. It should be clear we can look across the broad water to a real town, not only along a narrow stream. Keep the snow mountain and layered hills but compress the midground land to reveal more water. Water should occupy about 40% of the outdoor visible opening and continue behind the balcony railing. Maintain clear depth between room, balcony, tree, broad river, opposite town, hills, snowy mountains and sky. Leave open skyline space above the opposite town where 3 thin signal towers will be drawn by the game (DO NOT paint any towers or lights in the sky; those are animated code assets).
Style: restrained handsome handmade pixel art exactly consistent with reference. Crisp blocky edges, softly limited sage/blue/cream palette, bright mild daylight, expressive shadow values, no oily shine, no painterly smearing, no new UI, no lettering, no decorative border, no logos. Fully opaque. The bird feeder and branch coordinates must not move.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: image 1, the NEW wide-water Window Diary scene. Keep EXACTLY the same framing, all tree branches, tree hollow, nest, sill, pots, books, mug, feeder, railing, houses, wide water coverage, opposite-town skyline and snow mountain peaks. Do not change the geometry, add buildings or move objects. The broad river basin and long strip of town on its opposite shore must remain clear. Fully opaque clean handmade pixel art with restrained colors, crisp pixel edges and nuanced shadows. No interface, words, humans, birds, animals, insects, boats, towers, lanterns or fantasy events: these are animated separately. No painted falling precipitation; the game supplies moving particles. Change the whole physical landscape and illumination consistently for this atmosphere: Overcast gentle rain. Layered low gray clouds, hazy snow mountains, wet dark leaves, damp building walls and slate blue broad water with fine ripple texture. Opposite town windows glow in scattered warm small points and weak reflections. Indoor sill stays dry and cozy.
